memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: She drives a cab 8-10 hours daily, reports occasional knee discomfort after prolonged sitting but no limitation in daily activities.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative screen).
falls: No falls in the last 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (below 12 s, no raised fall risk).
medicines: 0 regular.
mood: Reports mild work‑related stress, denies depressive symptoms or anhedonia.
carers: Lives alone; sister Priya (sibling) provides occasional help.
goals: "I want to reduce my weight to feel more comfortable while driving and avoid knee pain."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: orlistat 120 mg with each main meal

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting lipid profile: total cholesterol 210 mg/dL (ref <200), LDL 130 mg/dL (<100), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40), triglycerides 165 mg/dL (<150).
Fasting glucose: 98 mg/dL (70‑99).
HbA1c: 5.6 % (4.0‑5.6).
Liver function: ALT 28 U/L (≤35), AST 24 U/L (≤34), GGT 32 U/L (≤51).
Waist circumference: 96 cm (female target <80 cm).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve started taking the capsules with breakfast, lunch and dinner. I feel a bit of bloating after meals but no diarrhoea. My energy levels are okay; I still get tired after long shifts. I’ve tried to cut sugary drinks and walk for 10 minutes after each fare.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:00 am with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports improved stamina; drives 9‑hour shifts with less knee ache. Still notes occasional bloating after meals.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative screen).
falls: No falls in past year, gait steady, TUG 9 seconds (no raised fall risk).
medicines: orlistat 120 mg TID – 1 regular.
mood: Describes mood as stable, denies anxiety or depression.
carers: Lives alone; sister Priya (sibling) checks in weekly by phone.
goals: "I would like to lose another 5 kg to feel lighter on the job."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: The bloating has lessened after I started taking the capsules with a glass of water and eating smaller portions. I’ve lost about 2 kg according to my home scale. My knees feel better when I climb into the cab. I’m motivated to keep going.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Next review appointment booked for 2025-10-15 at 09:30 am with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative screen).
